''See also: [[Phoenix Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The term Phoenix refers to several distinct entities within the world. One is a title held by Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel, the Sixth [[Judge]] of the [[Abidan Court]]. As a Phoenix, she serves as a vital bridge between other [[Judges]] and functions as a cosmic healer capable of restoring order and mending broken realities, though she can only return things to their previous states. The seventh generation of this lineage was eventually destroyed. Another entity is the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], a massive [[Dreadgod]] characterized by its liquid-red appearance and immense [[scale]]. This creature possesses a [[hunger]]-based nature, dispersing [[Blood Shadows]] across the world to gather power and rebuild its body. It is capable of manifesting in various forms, including a small human-like woman with scarlet wings or a massive mountain-sized beast. The [[Bleeding Phoenix]] is associated with the [[Redmoon Hall]] and can manipulate space, [[blood madra]], and red lightning. Additionally, the term describes a type of wild animal that leaves trails of red and orange light when flying. These creatures are considered [[natural treasures]] by fire artists, though they are noted to be unsuitable as pets for underwater environments.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[The Phoenix]] is a biological entity and a location that induces headaches in [[Heralds]], fueling a grudge held by [[Yerin]]. Described by the [[Sage of Red Faith]] as a fat mutant swollen with power, this being possesses the Authority{{!}}authority of a [[Sage]] and causes significant distress within the [[Hall]]. Its presence affects the Redmoon Emissaries{{!}}Emissaries of Redmoon Hall, leading to expectations that it will destroy everyone at its location. While it may have sent a chunk of itself, the entity known as Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel is capable of performing the work of an entire squad of lesser Phoenixes.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Phoenix]] manifests as a minor hunger aspects{{!}}hunger aspect within [[Yerin]]'s [[blood madra]]. While [[Yerin]] had been holding out for The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix, the entity eventually intervened during combat. It utilized a [[technique]] consisting of a hammer-blow of [[blood]] and [[force madra]] against its targets. Additionally, The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix launched a flurry of [[needles]] at [[Lindon]] and released a cloud of red [[poison]].}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Phoenix]] possesses the power to restore things to their former states and can be summoned to establish new rules or dismantle incorrect ones. While the entity would cooperate with The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King for the purpose of healing a world, its actions caused Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius to lose her home. Amidst the wreckage left behind, the people wait for their one Phoenix. Ultimately, the attack by The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix resulted in a memorial spire made of polished black [[stone]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Phoenixes can restore things to how they were before.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Phoenixes can be called to write new rules or break wrong ones.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Phoenix]] would cooperate with The Mad King{{!}}the Mad King to heal a world.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c7">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The people in the wreckage are waiting for their one [[Phoenix]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Phoenix]] attack resulted in a memorial spire of polished black [[stone]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Phoenix]] caused Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius to lose her home.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c13" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
